evidence.title: Async Code setup and workflow
evidence.finding: Documents a Docker-hosted Next.js/Flask coding-task workspace, Claude Code/Codex tasks, API-key setup, task submission, comparison and user-triggered PR creation.

evidence.title: Task container and coding CLI launcher
evidence.finding: Selects real Claude Code or Codex CLI commands and credentials; clones a repository per task, commits changed files and extracts patch/diff/before-and-after bodies. Containers are separate, but the Codex route enables privileged mode, all capabilities, host PID and unconfined security profiles.

evidence.title: Registered task and pull-request routes
evidence.finding: Each submitted task starts a background thread. The registered routes expose retained task data/diffs and create a GitHub branch/PR from a completed task patch.

evidence.title: Task detail interface
evidence.locator: TaskDetailPage; completed-task diff fetch; Create PR handler; DiffViewer render
evidence.finding: Task details load the task diff and render DiffViewer; the user can request a PR from a completed task. This connects actual displayed content to the task workflow.

evidence.title: Displayed before-and-after code
evidence.locator: FileMergeView lines43-125; LegacyDiffViewer lines196-275; DiffViewer lines281-355
evidence.finding: The interface creates CodeMirror views using before/after file text and a unified merge view; the fallback displays raw diff text. It displays code changes rather than only names/counts.

evidence.title: Application source license
evidence.locator: Apache License Version2.0 grant and terms
evidence.finding: The pinned application repository contains the Apache License2.0 text.
